methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch. Lili's lili.app domain returned JS-only/empty pages on every attempt; lili.co/plans returned full content and is treated as the primary source, corroborated by financebuzz.com and startupsavant.com. Novo has no public paid tiers; confirmed free-only via official site and two independent review sources. Relay Scale plan is currently discounted to $90/mo from the regular $120/mo; the regular published price is recorded as the plan price with a note about the active promotion. Bluevine fee waivers are possible but the published rack rate is recorded. Brex is priced per user/seat for the Premium tier. Rho publishes $0 subscription fees with transaction-based charges only. All accessedAt dates set to 2026-06-14 per dataset specification.

vendors.name: Mercury
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://mercury.com/pricing (fetched directly, full content returned)

plans.name: Mercury
plans.notes: Free forever. Core banking and finance essentials. Expense reimbursement free for up to 5 users/month. International wire conversion fee: 1% for non-USD transfers. Optional international wire OUR fee: $15 flat.

plans.name: Mercury Plus
plans.notes: Annual billing: $23.95/mo (15% discount). Month-to-month: $29.90/mo. Invoice with ACH debit at $1/transaction. Invoicing API 500 calls/month. Reimburse up to 20 users/month (+$5 per additional user). Unlimited 1099 filings. 6 months free Xero.

plans.name: Mercury Pro
plans.notes: Annual billing: $239.90/mo (15% discount). Month-to-month: $299/mo. Dedicated relationship manager. Invoice with ACH debit at $0/transaction. Unlimited invoicing API. NetSuite categorizations. Reimburse up to 250 users/month (+$5 per additional).

vendors.name: Novo
vendors.provenance: Official site novo.co and novo.co/business-checking confirmed single free plan with no paid tiers. Corroborated by airwallex.com/us/blog/novo-business-banking-review and nav.com/business-checking/novo-business-banking/.

plans.name: Novo Business Checking
plans.notes: Single free plan only. No minimum balance. No overdraft fees. ATM fee refunds (up to $7/month). Free ACH transfers. Free invoicing suite. NSF/returned-item fee: $27. No paid tiers published.

vendors.name: Bluevine
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://www.bluevine.com/business-checking/plans-and-pricing (fetched directly, full content returned). Corroborated by airwallex.com/us/blog/bluevine-business-checking-review.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: No monthly fee. 1.3% APY up to $250,000 (requires $500/mo debit spend OR $2,500/mo customer deposits to earn yield). Same-day ACH: $10. Domestic wire: $15. Printed checks: $1.50 each. International wire: $25 or 1.5% for foreign currency. Out-of-network ATM: $2.50.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Fee waivable with $20,000 average daily balance + $2,000/mo debit spend. 1.75% APY up to $250,000. Same-day ACH: $8. Domestic wire: $12. First 5 printed checks free/month ($1.50 each after). International wire: $12.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: Fee waivable with $100,000 average daily balance + $5,000/mo debit spend. 3.0% APY on all balances up to $3M. Same-day ACH: $5. Domestic wire: $7.50. First 20 printed checks free/month. International wire: $7.50. Advanced ACH debit controls included.

vendors.name: Relay
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://relayfi.com/pricing (fetched directly, full content returned). Scale plan regular price $120/mo confirmed; $90/mo is a limited-time promotional discount.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free. Up to 20 checking accounts. Debit and credit cards (virtual and physical). 1% cash back. 1.11% APY on savings (variable, as of 2026-05-01, tied to Federal Funds rate). Basic bill management. Payment links and invoicing.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: 1.25% cash back. 1.75% APY on savings (variable). Multi-step approval workflows, batch payments, reduced transaction fees. Recurring invoices with auto-charge.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Regular published price $120/mo. Currently discounted to $90/mo for a limited time. Up to 50 checking accounts. 1.5% cash back. 3.00% APY on savings (variable). Same-day ACH automation (10 free/month).

vendors.name: Found
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://www.found.com/pricing (fetched directly, full content returned). Annual prices and 25% discount confirmed.

plans.name: Found
plans.notes: Free forever. Business checking with Mastercard debit. Team debit cards with spending controls. Up to 10 sub-accounts (Pockets). Expense categorization, receipt scanning, real-time tax estimates. Contractor payments and 1099 e-filing. Unlimited invoicing. No APY. No cash back. Wire transfer: $15. Paper checks: $1 each.

plans.name: Found Plus
plans.notes: Annual billing: $315/year ($26.25/mo, save 25%). Month-to-month: $35/mo. 1.50% APY on balances up to $20,000. Transaction imports from external banks and apps. Unlimited auto-categorization rules and custom tags. Priority phone support. Schedule C / 1120 tax form generation. Quarterly tax payments in-app.

plans.name: Found Pro
plans.notes: Annual billing: $720/year ($60/mo, save 25%). Month-to-month: $80/mo. 2.50% APY on all balances (uncapped). 1% cash back on card purchases. Dedicated account manager. Premium metal debit card. Free check sending. Discounted wire transfers ($10 vs. $15 on other plans).

vendors.name: Lili
vendors.provenance: Official plans page: https://lili.co/plans (fetched directly, full content returned — lili.app domain returned JS-only/empty on all attempts). Corroborated by financebuzz.com/lili-bank-account-review and startupsavant.com/service-reviews/lili-banking.

plans.name: Lili Core
plans.notes: Free forever. Business checking account with debit card. ACH, check, and wire payments. Savings up to 4.00% APY. FDIC insurance up to $3M. Business credit access. 7-day customer support. Banking provided by Sunrise Banks, N.A.

plans.name: Lili Pro
plans.notes: Introductory promotion: $9/mo for first 3 months. Regular price: $15/mo. All Core features plus expense and tax management tools. No annual billing option published.

plans.name: Lili Smart
plans.notes: Introductory promotion: $21/mo for first 3 months. Regular price: $35/mo. All Pro features plus accounting software, bookkeeping automation, invoicing, bill management, and receipt capture. No annual billing option published.

plans.name: Lili Premium
plans.notes: Introductory promotion: $33/mo for first 3 months. Regular price: $55/mo. All Smart features plus dedicated priority support with specialist availability. No annual billing option published.

vendors.name: Brex
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://www.brex.com/pricing (fetched directly, full content returned). Integration list from https://www.brex.com/product/integrations and WebSearch corroboration.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $0 per user per month. Includes corporate cards, expense management, cash management account, bill pay, and travel booking. No monthly fees, no account minimums, no overdraft fees on the banking account.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $12 per user per month. Adds advanced expense controls, multi-entity support, dedicated travel services, HRIS integrations, and enhanced accounting automation. No annual discount published.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Contact sales. Includes local card setup in 50+ countries, automated VAT tracking, offline travel booking support, and a designated senior consultant.

vendors.name: Rho
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://rho.co/pricing (fetched directly, full content returned). Integrations from https://rho.co/integrations (fetched directly).

plans.name: Rho Business Banking
plans.notes: $0 subscription fee. No per-user fees. Includes checking account, same-day ACH, wires, checks, AP automation, expense management, and accounting integrations at $0. Transaction fees apply: 1% on foreign currency transfers; optional $15 SWIFT fee for international USD wires. Rho Treasury management fee disclosed separately in ADV-2A Wrap Fee Brochure (not published inline).
